name: Mark the points
description: Tap points onto a coordinate grid: roots, vertices, intersections. Graded by matching your points to the expected ones; extra points cost credit. Can generate a new curve every review.

fields.name: points
fields.description: Expected points, a list of [x, y].

fields.name: labels
fields.description: Optional names for the expected points, in the same order (markdown, e.g. "vertex").

fields.name: tolerance
fields.description: How far a point may be from the expected one, in grid units.

fields.name: snap
fields.description: Grid snapping for placed points, in grid units (0 for none).

fields.name: curve
fields.description: Optional JavaScript expression in x drawn after grading, e.g. x*x - 2*x - 3.
